items.title: Open Source Flutter Apps
items.content_text:
### Productivity

*   [Daily You](https://openappscout.com/apps/daily_you/) - A private daily journal with moods, photos and Markdown notes, stored on your device with no account. ([Source (⭐1.4k)](https://github.com/Demizo/Daily_You))
*   [LocalMind](https://openappscout.com/apps/localmind/) - Chat with AI models offline on your phone or through your own Ollama or LM Studio server. ([Source (⭐271)](https://github.com/abdulmominsakib/localmind))
*   [StoryPad](https://openappscout.com/apps/storypad/) - A private diary app with a timeline, mood tags, photos, a PIN or biometric lock and optional Google Drive sync. ([Source (⭐971)](https://github.com/theachoem/storypad))
*   [Table Habit](https://openappscout.com/apps/mhabit/) - Habit tracker with growth-curve scores, local storage and WebDAV sync, for Android, iOS and desktop. ([Source (⭐1.7k)](https://github.com/FriesI23/mhabit))

### Finance

*   [Cake Wallet](https://openappscout.com/apps/cake_wallet/) - A non-custodial wallet for Monero, Bitcoin, Ethereum and more, on iOS, Android, macOS, Windows and Linux. ([Source (⭐2k)](https://github.com/cake-tech/cake_wallet))
*   [Fingrom](https://openappscout.com/apps/app-finance/) - An ad-free personal finance app with multi-currency accounts, budgets and encrypted sync across devices. ([Source (⭐137)](https://github.com/lyskouski/app-finance))
*   [Invoice Ninja Admin Portal](https://openappscout.com/apps/admin-portal/) - Invoice Ninja's app for quotes, invoices, payments and time tracking on mobile, desktop and web. ([Source (⭐1.8k)](https://github.com/invoiceninja/admin-portal))
*   [Oinkoin](https://openappscout.com/apps/oinkoin/) - Offline, ad-free expense tracker for Android, Windows and Linux with budgets, charts and biometric lock. ([Source (⭐476)](https://github.com/emavgl/oinkoin))
*   [Peercoin Flutter](https://openappscout.com/apps/peercoin_flutter/) - Self-custodial Peercoin wallet for Android, iOS and the web, with seed phrase backup and testnet. ([Source (⭐32)](https://github.com/peercoin/peercoin_flutter))
*   [Sossoldi](https://openappscout.com/apps/sossoldi/) - A net worth and personal finance tracker for expenses, income and investments, on mobile, desktop and web. ([Source (⭐1.4k)](https://github.com/RIP-Comm/sossoldi))
*   [Waterfly III](https://openappscout.com/apps/waterfly-iii/) - An unofficial Android app for Firefly III to track accounts, budgets and bills from your phone. ([Source (⭐727)](https://github.com/dreautall/waterfly-iii))

### Tools

*   [API Dash](https://openappscout.com/apps/apidash/) - A cross-platform API client for testing web APIs, with code generation for 20+ languages. ([Source (⭐2.9k)](https://github.com/foss42/apidash))
*   [Brethap](https://openappscout.com/apps/brethap/) - A breathing and meditation timer with custom breathing patterns, tones, vibration and a session log. ([Source (⭐86)](https://github.com/jithware/brethap))
*   [Glim](https://openappscout.com/apps/glim/) - A free Mac file viewer for Markdown, PDFs, images, JSON, CSV and code in one workspace. ([Source (⭐17)](https://github.com/NeoPanic/Glim))
*   [Onion Browser](https://openappscout.com/apps/onionbrowser/) - Private web browser for iPhone and iPad that routes your browsing through the Tor network. ([Source (⭐2.7k)](https://github.com/OnionBrowser/OnionBrowser))
*   [ServerBox](https://openappscout.com/apps/flutter_server_box/) - Monitor and manage your servers over SSH with live charts, a terminal and SFTP, on phone and desktop. ([Source (⭐8.8k)](https://github.com/lollipopkit/flutter_server_box))

### Developer Tools

*   [iSH](https://openappscout.com/apps/ish/) - Run a Linux shell and command-line tools on your iPhone and iPad. ([Source (⭐21k)](https://github.com/ish-app/ish))
*   [Local Codex & Claude Analytics Ledger](https://openappscout.com/apps/codex-claude-analytics-ledger/) - See your Codex and Claude Code sessions, token usage and API-equivalent cost on a local dashboard. ([Source (⭐2)](https://github.com/imnakul/codex-analytics))
*   [Roxum IDE](https://openappscout.com/apps/roxum-ide/) - A code editor for Android phones with a file tree, terminal, code completion, Git and offline AI chat. ([Source (⭐634)](https://github.com/heckmon/roxum-ide))
*   [RustDesk](https://openappscout.com/apps/rustdesk/) - A self-hostable remote desktop app for screen sharing, file transfer and unattended access, like TeamViewer. ([Source (⭐126k)](https://github.com/rustdesk/rustdesk))

### Communication

*   [Thunderbird for iOS](https://openappscout.com/apps/thunderbird-ios/) - Thunderbird's email app for iPhone and iPad, in early development. ([Source (⭐1.2k)](https://github.com/thunderbird/thunderbird-ios))

### Health and Fitness

*   [Medito](https://openappscout.com/apps/medito-app/) - Free meditation app for Android and iOS with guided sessions and courses, and no ads, sign-up or paywall. ([Source (⭐1.3k)](https://github.com/meditohq/medito-app))

### Business

*   [Flutter POS System](https://openappscout.com/apps/flutter-pos-system/) - An offline point-of-sale app for small restaurants and shops, with menus, orders, stock and receipt printing. ([Source (⭐620)](https://github.com/evan361425/flutter-pos-system))

### Media

*   [Kodi](https://openappscout.com/apps/xbmc/) - A free home theater and media center that plays and organizes your video and music on almost any device. ([Source (⭐21k)](https://github.com/xbmc/xbmc))
*   [One Second Diary](https://openappscout.com/apps/one_second_diary/) - Video diary for Android that records one short clip a day and stitches them into a movie of your life. ([Source (⭐412)](https://github.com/KyleKun/one_second_diary))
*   [Swift Radio Pro](https://openappscout.com/apps/swift-radio-pro/) - An iPhone radio station app template with live streams, now-playing info, album art and CarPlay controls. ([Source (⭐2.9k)](https://github.com/analogcode/Swift-Radio-Pro))

### Entertainment

*   [ATV Bilibili](https://openappscout.com/apps/atv-bilibili-demo/) - An unofficial Bilibili video client for Apple TV, built around the tvOS remote and focus interface. ([Source (⭐3.2k)](https://github.com/yichengchen/ATV-Bilibili-demo))

### Social Network

*   [Ice Cubes](https://openappscout.com/apps/icecubesapp/) - A fast Mastodon app for iPhone, iPad, Mac and Vision Pro that works with any instance. ([Source (⭐7.1k)](https://github.com/Dimillian/IceCubesApp))

### Shopping

*   [Label StoreMax](https://openappscout.com/apps/flutter-woocommerce-app/) - A ready-made Android and iOS shopping app template for WooCommerce stores. ([Source (⭐713)](https://github.com/woosignal/flutter-woocommerce-app))

### News and Magazine

*   [FeedFlow](https://openappscout.com/apps/feed-flow/) - A minimal RSS reader with apps for Android, iPhone, Mac, Windows and Linux. ([Source (⭐1.3k)](https://github.com/prof18/feed-flow))

*   [Building a Browser Solar System Explorer with NASA Data and Raw WebGL2](https://dev.to/wudao0123/building-a-browser-solar-system-explorer-with-nasa-data-and-raw-webgl2-5bkj) - Engineering case study on rendering the [Space Simulator Online](https://spacesimulator.online/) 3D Solar System, Milky Way, and 6,000+ NASA exoplanets at 60 FPS using raw WebGL 2 shaders without Three.js.

items.title: Awesome Mac
items.content_text:
### Design and Product / Other Tools

*   [Featherview](https://featherview.mynetx.net) - Open-source, keyboard-driven image viewer for flipping through folders, with batch conversion. [![Open-Source Software](https://jaywcjlove.github.io/sb/ico/min-oss.svg "Open Source Software")](https://github.com/featherview/featherview) ![Freeware](https://jaywcjlove.github.io/sb/ico/min-free.svg "Freeware") ![Native App](https://jaywcjlove.github.io/sb/ico/min-native-app.svg "Native App")
*   [Jutsu Studio](https://jutsustudio.com/) - Open-source, unofficial Higgsfield client for creating AI videos and images with Seedance, Kling and Genjutsu, with every result kept on your disk. [![Open-Source Software](https://jaywcjlove.github.io/sb/ico/min-oss.svg "Open Source Software")](https://github.com/jutsuhq/jutsu-studio) ![Freeware](https://jaywcjlove.github.io/sb/ico/min-free.svg "Freeware")
*   [Swapjutsu](https://jutsustudio.com/swapjutsu/) - Open-source character swap tool for videos with Seedance 2.5 or Wan 2.2 Animate, with on-device preparation on Apple silicon. [![Open-Source Software](https://jaywcjlove.github.io/sb/ico/min-oss.svg "Open Source Software")](https://github.com/jutsuhq/swapjutsu-seedance-character-swap) ![Freeware](https://jaywcjlove.github.io/sb/ico/min-free.svg "Freeware")

### Finance / Audio Record and Process

*   [Moony](https://moonyfinance.com) - Personal finance app for tracking accounts, investments, crypto, property and loans in an encrypted local database, with no account, no cloud and no telemetry. [![Open-Source Software](https://jaywcjlove.github.io/sb/ico/min-oss.svg "Open Source Software")](https://github.com/fiiles/Moony) ![Freeware](https://jaywcjlove.github.io/sb/ico/min-free.svg "Freeware")

items.title: Game Datasets
items.content_text:
### API

*   [unicum.gg](https://unicum.gg/docs) - World of Tanks player, clan, tank and map statistics across EU, NA and Asia, free and with no key. [Website](https://unicum.gg).

### Dataset / Web

*   [OSTDB (⭐2)](https://github.com/OSTDB/soundtracks) - Official video game soundtracks (2,300+ albums for 1,800+ games) with Spotify, Apple Music and album.link URLs, as CSV, JSON and SQLite. [Website](https://ostdb.net), [API](https://ostdb.net/api).
